scientific_purpose: No-fit structural/source-leak test of an original-2head-soft native historical calendar/belief query head. Only historic-time source timestamp metadata as query, original past observation flows through recurrent memory; physically observed anchor PM2.5 high vs normal used ONLY after forward for loss. Test original writer/future forecast exact unchanged, state/params budgets and honest source gradients.
model_original_source_family: source original 2h-soft LATFUSE004, 99261 params, original 1696 FP32+16 owner flags 6800 nominal bytes
candidate: 2head16value×8key unchanged delta writer/retention, encoder and current forecast; new historic_clock_query Linear6→16 and historic_event_head Linear16→1; 99390 live trained+deployed params, 129 more, no new carried state, no persistent history queue
ground_truth: Recorded past PM2.5 z>=1.25 vs ordinary abs(z)<=0.25 from original March-Apr2014 FIT sources, station/hour matching and source history t-23..t+64; target event category read for BCE only after query performed, no historic measured value/label input to the query; 6D legal past timestamp only.
loss: 0.8 authentic +6h future GaussianNLL+0.2 masked MAE PLUS observed historic binary event BCE, all targets read only after forward. This differs from original LATFUSE004 training objectives, no fair architecture comparison.
probe_settings: zero AdamW or other optimizer steps. 8 source cases representing four observed original matched source event/control pairs, 24 pre-event hours+64 observed continuation. Torch FP32 CPU single thread, full-source/model SHA, check real source gradients for every present parameter tensor.
source_split_limit: Original UCI501 original FIT numerical only. No already-exposed 2015 numeric, protected2016–2017 numeric, or ungrounded synthetic ability tests.
scientific_boundary: Does not demonstrate trained historical recall, usefulness of longer memory, full neural parallel time scan or finite-precision AD/probability-law proof. A full real training head-to-head requires separate prior registration, actual FULL-training-FLOP parity <=1%, parameter parity <=1%, exact matched genuine original source samples/seeds/optimizer and protected evaluation approval.
